title: Threer
tagline: Revolutionize freelancing with our decentralized platform! Easy social login via Wallet Connect, fair builder scores with Talent Protocol Passport, and fast, secure payments. Bridging Web2 clients and Web3 freelancers effortlessly.

description:
Project Vision:
The goal is to create a secure, transparent, and efficient environment where clients and freelancers can interact without the need for intermediaries. By utilizing decentralized platforms, we create trustless platform for payments and builder qualifications

Key Features:

User Profiles and Dashboards:

Client Profile
Clients can create their profiles with their telegram handles and see the offers they purchased from their client profile

Developer Profile
Developers can update their profiles, submit offers, and manage their jobs. Also they can track their work history and builder scores.

Project Browser Tab
Search and Filter: Users can browse available projects on our platform and buy the offer they want if they are registered as client

View Profiles: Users can view the profiles of other clients or developers by entering their address in the URL

https://threer.vercel.app/clientprofile/{walletaddress}
https://threer.vercel.app/devprofile/{walletaddress}

Benefits of the Platform
Decentralization: Removes the need for intermediaries, reducing costs and increasing transparency.
Fairness: The decentralized scoring system guarantees unbiased and fair evaluations for all freelancers.
Efficiency: Fast and secure payments streamline the transaction process, enhancing the overall user experience.

Conclusion

Our platform is designed to bridge the gap between traditional freelancing and the decentralized world of Web3. By providing easy onboarding, fair evaluations, and secure transactions, we aim to create a freelancing ecosystem that is transparent, efficient, and inclusive for all users.
how_its_made:
We have utilized Next.js for our frontend, providing a dynamic and responsive user interface. Our backend is powered by smart contracts, which handle all operations and securely store client, developer, and offer data on the blockchain. The application is hosted on Vercel, ensuring a reliable and scalable deployment environment.

Partner technologies we have used:

Social Login via Wallet Connect
Easy Adaptation: Users can log in using their social media accounts through Wallet Connect, making it seamless for Web2 users to transition to Web3.

On-ramping with Coinbase
Smooth Transition: Clients can easily convert their fiat currency to cryptocurrency using Coinbase, facilitating a smooth onboarding process.
Convenience: This feature is especially convenient for users who are new to cryptocurrency.

Talent Protocol Passport
Decentralized Scoring: Freelancers receive a builder score based on their onchain performance, ensuring fair and unbiased evaluations.
Equal Opportunities: Unlike traditional platforms like LinkedIn, our scoring system does not rely on personal opinions or conflicts, creating an equal opportunity environment for all users.
